publicInputs.name: tleHash
publicInputs.description: Poseidon commitment to NORAD TLE orbital ephemeris parameters

publicInputs.name: geographicCellId
publicInputs.description: Coarse geographic cell ID bounding observer region without revealing exact coordinates

publicInputs.name: nominalCarrierFrequencyHz
publicInputs.description: Downlink carrier frequency in Hz (nominally 11,325,000,000 for Ku-band)

publicInputs.name: maxRmseToleranceHz
publicInputs.description: Maximum allowable Doppler RMSE deviation (nominally 2500 Hz)

publicInputs.name: passStartTimeMs
publicInputs.description: UTC timestamp in milliseconds marking start of satellite pass window

publicInputs.name: passEndTimeMs
publicInputs.description: UTC timestamp in milliseconds marking end of satellite pass window

privateWitness.name: exactLatitudeDegFixed
privateWitness.description: Exact observer latitude in Q32.32 fixed-point representation

privateWitness.name: exactLongitudeDegFixed
privateWitness.description: Exact observer longitude in Q32.32 fixed-point representation

privateWitness.name: exactAltitudeMeters
privateWitness.description: Exact observer altitude above WGS84 ellipsoid in meters

privateWitness.name: sampleFrequenciesHz
privateWitness.description: Discrete empirical RF carrier frequency measurements

privateWitness.name: sampleTimestampsMs
privateWitness.description: UTC sample timestamps corresponding to each frequency measurement

privateWitness.name: siliconEnclaveSignature
privateWitness.description: Binary quote signature from Intel SGX DCAP or TPM 2.0 enclave

geofenceCellInclusion.description: Constrains exact observer coordinates to fall within geographicCellId bounding box

keplerianStateInversion.description: Computes satellite ECEF position and line-of-sight velocity vector per sample

relativisticDopplerResidual.description: Constrains aggregate Doppler frequency RMSE <= maxRmseToleranceHz

enclaveTelemetryBinding.description: Verifies that sample frequencies match the payload certified by the silicon enclave
